note: Woods County OK (FIPS 40151) publishes no queryable zoning district layer. Searched ArcGIS Hub/Online and web. Woods County's ArcGIS layers (Woods_County_Data by twoody_uok) cover boundaries, districts and roads only; the county mapping service (mapping@woodscountyok.gov) holds 911 address data only. The county seat Alva's code (§10.20) says its zoning map is kept on file with the City Clerk, not published as a service. Parcel sources show zoning fields almost entirely unpopulated.
